example: a debug build with and without the flag

steps.line: * When a debug build of palantir launches without the inspector launch flag
* Then it creates no inspector socket

expect.that: .bare.pid as $p | (.listed.exit == 0 or .listed.exit == 2) and ((.listed.sockets // []) | all((.pid | tostring) != ($p | tostring)))
expect.why: no inspector socket is listed for the palantir launched without the flag
palantir-inspect finds no socket to reach that palantir
